plain_english: How your money is divided across buckets, assets, or strategies.
why_it_matters_here: Your low, medium, and high risk pools are a short-term trading version of allocation control.
source_name: SEC Investor.gov - Asset Allocation and Diversification

plain_english: How much loss or volatility you can realistically tolerate while pursuing returns.
why_it_matters_here: The bot should not recommend high-risk allocation merely because the target return is high; it must respect account survival limits.
source_name: SEC Investor.gov - Asset Allocation and Diversification

plain_english: Spreading money across different investments or strategies to reduce dependence on one outcome.
why_it_matters_here: The low/medium/high buckets should avoid concentrating all daily capital in one symbol, sector, or setup.
source_name: SEC Investor.gov - Asset Allocation, Diversification, and Rebalancing 101

plain_english: An order to buy or sell immediately at the current available market price.
why_it_matters_here: Fast execution can come with uncertain price, especially in volatile or thinly traded names.

plain_english: An order to buy or sell only at a specified price or better.
why_it_matters_here: Useful when price discipline matters more than guaranteed execution.

plain_english: An order that becomes a market order once a specified stop price is reached.
why_it_matters_here: Stop rules are part of account survival, but execution price is not guaranteed after the stop triggers.

plain_english: Buying and selling, or selling and buying, the same security on the same day in a margin account.
why_it_matters_here: The system must track day trades so the user understands rule exposure and account restrictions.

plain_english: A trader generally flagged after four or more day trades within five business days, if those day trades exceed 6% of total trades in that period.
why_it_matters_here: The bot should warn when trading frequency approaches PDT territory.

plain_english: A margin-account buying-power calculation tied to prior-day equity and margin requirements.
why_it_matters_here: The bot should not treat broker buying power as permission to risk the full amount.

plain_english: A demand to deposit more funds or securities when the account no longer meets required margin levels.
why_it_matters_here: The live-tracking profile should detect margin-risk conditions before they become broker-enforced problems.
